briefs.image_prompt:
Advertising photograph for Sujal's Shoes.

REFERENCES — preserve these exactly:
Image 1 is the human model. Preserve the model's face, skin tone, hair and body proportions exactly as shown. Do not restyle the face.
Image 2 is the product. Preserve its exact shape, colour, proportions, label text and finish. The product must be immediately recognisable as the same item.

SHOT:
- side profile view of the subject
- soft diffused studio lighting, gentle even shadows
- subject on the left third, open space to the right
- smooth soft colour gradient backdrop

LOOK:
- Mood: calm, premium, understated and expensive-looking
- Colour palette: #d3d2dd, #271959, #63568b, #b1a9d7, #100831
- Format: 9:16 vertical-safe framing for instagram reels

CONSTRAINTS:
- Keep the product and the model's face clear of the top 14% and bottom 20% of the frame, which platform UI covers.
- The product must be fully visible and unobstructed.
- Photorealistic commercial photography. No text overlays, captions or graphic elements — those are composited later.

ADDITIONAL DIRECTION: the shoes should be in the hands of the human model or pointing the direction towards the shoes
